fee_notes: Non-refundable; deferred for CA/VA franchisees until franchisor completes initial obligations. Area developers pay $35,000 for first franchise plus $17,500 per additional unit (Development Fee for 3-5 outlets: $70,000-$105,000).
raw_excerpt: Upon execution of this Agreement, Franchisee shall pay a fee ("Franchise Fee") to Franchisor of $35,000. The Franchise Fee shall be deemed fully earned upon execution of this Agreement and is non-refundable
